_doc: Roster-100 Wave 2 item M2 (2026-11-05): visible debt registry for the portrait freshness gate in test/portraits.test.mjs. 'placeholders' names EXACTLY the fighters whose select card is the shared placeholder PNG (sha256 below, 6,523 B) because no model is wired for them at all (model: null in game/js/roster-full.js) — Wave 3 item L3 (missing models x7) retires them. Their portraits-manifest.json entries claim captures from other fighters' models (steve-fox / pantera); those claims are known-false, are the #1565 inventory finding this gate exists to catch, and retire with L3. The registry must SHRINK as L3 lands: the test fails if a registered fighter's card bytes change (remove the entry in the same PR that gives the fighter a real card), if an unregistered card carries the placeholder bytes, or if any byte-identical card group exists that is neither this placeholder set nor a registered knownDuplicateGroups entry. 'knownDuplicateGroups' is the separate duplicate-card class (same bytes, real capture): ryuji.png is byte-identical to ryuji-rock.png because ryuji is the hidden same-body hybrid (owner ruling #6, docs/handoffs/ROSTER-100-FIX-2026-11-04.md); remove that entry when the ruling resolves the pair.

knownDuplicateGroups.reason: same body by design; ryuji hidden; duplicate card rides owner ruling #6 (ryuji hybrid) in docs/handoffs/ROSTER-100-FIX-2026-11-04.md

placeholders.byou: no model wired (L3); manifest falsely claims a steve-fox capture
